confirmed_source_path.fact: A 70 ms hover submenu creation turns hideOnWindowDeactivate off, creates the dialog, calls windowSystem.forceActive(childDialog.mainItem), then sets mainItem.focus=true.
The exact Plasma 6.3.6 WindowSystem::forceActive implementation unconditionally calls KX11Extras::forceActiveWindow(window->winId()); it has no Wayland guard.
monitorWindowVisibility only connects QQuickWindow::visibilityChanged; it is not the source of the X11-only warning.
The submenu sets kicker.expanded=false when that dialog receives windowDeactivated, except during destruction.
